is_permitted.caption: Is Permitted
is_permitted.description: Whether the action was permitted. False means the action was denied and did not execute.

reason_code.caption: Reason Code
reason_code.description: The producer's closed-vocabulary code explaining the decision. A closed vocabulary is required: free text cannot be correlated and cannot be audited.

reason_code_id.caption: Reason Code ID
reason_code_id.description: Numeric form of reason_code, where the producer defines one.

1.caption: Allow - Direct Authority
1.description: Permitted by the principal's own authority, with no delegation involved.

2.caption: Allow - Delegated Authority
2.description: Permitted under a delegation grant held by the acting principal.

3.caption: Allow - Break Glass
3.description: Permitted under a time-boxed, dual-approved emergency grant. Emergency access is a grant, never an exemption.

10.caption: Deny - No Grant
10.description: No authority of any kind covers the request. Absence of a permit is a denial.

11.caption: Deny - Out Of Scope
11.description: A grant exists but does not cover this resource.

12.caption: Deny - Purpose Mismatch
12.description: A grant exists but is bound to a different declared purpose.

13.caption: Deny - Limit Exceeded
13.description: An aggregate limit was consulted and exceeded. The limit that tripped is named in limits[].

14.caption: Deny - Grant Revoked
14.description: The grant was revoked before the request arrived.

15.caption: Deny - Revoked In Flight
15.description: The grant was revoked while the operation was already running, and the grant elected to fail.

16.caption: Deny - Element Not Permitted
16.description: The resource is in scope but the specific data element requested is not.

17.caption: Deny - Unmapped Access Site
17.description: A data-access site was reached that no policy binds. An unmapped site denies.

18.caption: Deny - Page Cap Exceeded
18.description: A list request exceeded the declared maximum page size. Refused, never silently truncated.

99.caption: Other
99.description: A reason the enum does not yet cover. reason_code carries the detail.

is_shadow.caption: Is Shadow
is_shadow.description: True when the decision was produced by simulation or shadow evaluation and did NOT affect the response. Consumers MUST exclude shadow decisions from detections and metrics; a stream that cannot distinguish them is unusable for either.

state_age.caption: State Age
state_age.description: Age in milliseconds of the authority state consulted, at decision time. A permit issued against stale state is not equivalent to one issued against current state.

purpose.caption: Purpose
purpose.description: The declared purpose the actor was acting for. Required for delegated and autonomous-agent actions, where authority is bounded by purpose as well as by scope.

enforcement_point.caption: Enforcement Point
enforcement_point.description: Where in the running system the decision was made and enforced.

delegation.caption: Delegation
delegation.description: The delegated authority in force at decision time, if any.

limits.caption: Limits
limits.description: Aggregate limits consulted while making the decision.

released_attributes.caption: Released Attributes
released_attributes.description: Names of the data elements actually released to the caller. Element names only, never element values: an evidence stream carrying values becomes a duplicate of the data it protects, aggregated across principals and retained for audit periods.

withheld_attributes.caption: Withheld Attributes
withheld_attributes.description: Names of the data elements withheld from the caller. A count alone is insufficient, because a caller receiving seven of ten elements needs to know which three are absent rather than assuming a complete view.

response_mode.caption: Response Mode
response_mode.description: Whether the operation composed atomically or returned only the permitted subset. One of atomic or partial. Atomic is the closed default; partial is a declared degradation.

entitlement_mode.caption: Entitlement Mode
entitlement_mode.description: Whether element entitlement was evaluated per record or once for the operation under a declared invariance. One of per_record or invariant. A wrong invariance declaration applies one record mask to every record, which is a data leak produced by a performance hint.

withheld_count.caption: Withheld Count
withheld_count.description: Records omitted from a list response because the principal was not entitled to them. Reported alongside the authorized total so a caller can never mistake a restricted view for a complete one.

evidence_granularity.caption: Evidence Granularity
evidence_granularity.description: Whether this evidence entry covers a single record decision or one list operation. One of per_record or per_operation. Stated in the entry so a reader knows which contract they are reading rather than inferring it.

tenant_uid.caption: Tenant UID
tenant_uid.description: The tenant the decision was made within. Present in every sample and required for multi-tenant deployments, where a decision is meaningless without knowing whose data it concerned.

stage_id.caption: Decision Stage
stage_id.description: Which of the three decision points enforced this decision. Request means no data access occurred at all, which is the difference between preventing a disclosure and filtering one after the fact.

1.caption: Request
1.description: Decided before any data access is composed or issued. No I/O is performed at all.

2.caption: Access
2.description: Decided as the outbound access is composed, narrowing the projection to permitted elements.

3.caption: Delivery
3.description: Decided as the response is composed, determining which elements reach this caller.

stage.caption: Decision Stage Detail
stage.description: The vendor-specific stage label, alongside stage_id.
